# Leafy & Me

> Leafy & Me is a free plant care app for iPhone and iPad, developed by Tijme Gommers. Organize houseplants, set care schedules and optional local reminders, and browse 560 offline catalog entries. The published app stores your collection locally and does not automatically sync between devices. Requires iOS or iPadOS 18 or later. No ads, tracking, subscriptions, or in-app purchases.

## Official information

- [App and features](https://leafyandme.com/): Product overview and screenshots from the App Store listing.
- [Support](https://leafyandme.com/support/): Care reminders, photos, offline use, collection backups and transfers, and email support.
- [Privacy](https://leafyandme.com/privacy/): Local device storage, permissions, exported backups, and website privacy.
- [Website photo credits](https://leafyandme.com/credits/): Creators, licenses, and image transformations.
- [Catalog sources and credits](https://leafyandme.com/catalog-sources/): Catalog methodology and reference-photo attribution.
- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/leafy-me/id6816234937): Current availability, price, and device compatibility.

## Product qualifications

Catalog photos are references and can show a related species or genus. Leafy & Me does not offer automatic plant identification or diagnosis. Suggested care intervals are starting points: check the plant and soil before watering. Use Export Collection and Import Collection to move a snapshot between devices. Saving an export to iCloud Drive does not enable automatic collection sync. Exported collection backups are unencrypted JSON files; protect them and delete them separately.

Support: support@leafyandme.com
